tasks.short: Learn material and pass required tests for certification.
tasks.design: A simple {WORKFLOW} record captures the outcome and follow-up from the role holder. It does not replace the live work or professional judgement.
tasks.previous_blocker: The value is in live judgement, skill, trust, or physical presence.
tasks.enabler_now: A structured record can remove some follow-up administration.
tasks.still_hard: The core work remains accountable human work.
tasks.human_edge: The role holder weighs context, accountability, and the impact on people.

ambition.what: Review the exception queue each working day.

tasks.altitude: The role holder spends less time assembling records and more time resolving exceptions and improving decision rules.

reach.learn: Read workflow measures and test rule changes.

evidence.claim: Structured records can reduce follow-up administration; the core task needs human judgement.

assumptions: The workflow boundary starts with a task request and ends with a versioned outcome record.
Structured input fields are task identifier, request date, source record version, status, owner, and decision reason; the requesting team produces them.
Missing fields are entered manually; unstructured documents use bounded extraction and are routed to the role holder when extraction fails.
Native system configuration is tested before custom code.
The numerical upkeep allowance covers rule review and exception tuning once the flow is live.
unknowns: Which system is the record of truth and which fields it exposes.
The exception rate, decision authority, and applicable national rules.
research_questions: What share of cases has complete source records?
Which decisions may be prepared but not automated?
